Visitor flow and a short update
The desk is glad to help last week
Travelers: smooth pet check-ins are still the focus at Aurelia Skyways.

Please bring your animal travel papers, carrier details, and any care notes before you head to the counter. The Companion Animal Travel Desk will review basic needs, confirm comfort points, and keep each plan practical for the trip. We look at species, temperament, and comfort so the handoff stays calm and clear.

If your pet is nervous, please say so early. That helps the team make simple choices for spacing, handling, and boarding order. The desk also stays ready for routine questions from travelers moving between skyports, and the tone stays warm and professional from start to finish.

If you have a last-minute update, bring it to the desk right away. Companion Animal Travel Desk
